cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: What Rule Did I Miss?
cards.instruction: Find the hidden rule that makes the strange situation consistent, practical, or at least survivable.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Your shadow moved before you. What changed? Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was thinking of leaving, but I can't find the exit.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Think about that bench without moving. Does it turn?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's gone to the bench. I'm still here.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: It seems to follow your intentions. Think about the exit again; let's follow slowly and see whether it knows the way.

mechanism: A takes charge of finding an exit and stays alongside B while testing whether a leading shadow follows intentions.
confusable: Unlike merely accepting a moving shadow, A seeks a reproducible rule and uses it to navigate out.
comparison: A route-finding mental test differs from directing soup with a utensil.
seedUse: D150-b shadow, bench, intended exit; S02-b offers company and leads the practical use of B observation.
